summary: acer aspire 7 gaming system experiencing intermittent crashes, freezes, and BSODs with a stop code of dpc_watchdog_violation during gaming sessions.
detected_fault: Potential thermal issue due to inadequate cooling system or malfunctioning fans, exacerbated by high graphics settings.
suggested_solution: Update Graphics Card Driver to the latest version and check and update BIOS to the latest version, run a stress test (e.g., Prime95) to identify potential thermal issues.
